title: About KivoReach: Why We Built It, Vision and Purpose
description: KivoReach (formerly AMK Digital Agency) is an AI-based digital marketing company with free SEO tools. Why we built it, our vision and how we work.

blocks.html: KivoReach is an AI-based digital marketing company that helps businesses get found, trusted and chosen, on Google and in AI search. We build SEO systems that work with generative search engines, large language model crawlers and traditional search indexes. KivoReach was previously called AMK Digital Agency.

Search is changing. People now get answers from AI assistants as well as from search engines, and many small businesses cannot tell whether they show up in either. Good SEO tools are often expensive, and a business that is found can still lose visitors when its pages do not earn trust.

So we built three things: free tools that show the real state of a website, free guides that explain how to fix it, and expert help for businesses that want it done for them. Our rule is simple: real data only. If a tool cannot measure something, it says so. We never invent numbers or promise rankings.

items: KivoReach Tools: free SEO tools with daily free limits, for business owners, marketers and students.
KivoReach Academy: free docs, articles and guides, our free learning hub.
KivoReach Agency: SEO, AI search optimization (GEO and AEO), paid ads, social media, email outreach and lead generation.
KivoReach Studio: an invite-only workspace for deeper audits and monitoring.

blocks.html: To lead the next stage of search experience optimization and generative engine optimization. We see a future where digital authority is not bought, but built through clear credibility signals, semantic alignment and transparency.
To help close the digital trust gap. Searchers and AI systems look for verification. We build data layers, schema structures and E-E-A-T strategies that connect first impressions to real enquiries.
To replace guesswork with a clear framework: sound content structure, clean technical crawling, better search index presence and support for sustainable growth.
We structure pages so that AI search assistants and AI answer engines can find, understand and cite them.
We run diagnostic scans covering index status, Core Web Vitals and crawl settings so search engines can reach key content.
We align site structure with search engines' published experience, expertise, authoritativeness and trust guidance, using structured data, author details and clear trust signals.
